author: Haruko
name: HaruAdmins
short: Persistent timeouts, bot protection, and channel honeypots.
description: Adds persistent timeouts, unapproved-bot protection, and owner-managed channel honeypots with kick or timeout-then-kick actions.
install_msg: HaruAdmins loaded. Use /timeout, /botprotection, or /honeypot for its moderation features.
end_user_data_statement: Stores timeout target and moderator Discord IDs, expiration times, and reasons for long timeouts; bot-protection role, channel, and whitelisted bot IDs; and honeypot channel, role, suspect, and scheduled-kick data.
